prose: Marty Leeds returns to InnerVerse! As the Gnostic Academy's Preacher-Teacher, Marty has been delivering transcendent truths and mathematical mysticism for years, with Biblical analysis that you're not going to find at the average Sunday School. We discuss his new book, Gnosticism Defined: The Tenets of the Order, the Prisca Theologia, and his stance on sin & salvation, misconceptions on the demiurge, symbolism of the serpent, and the origin of evil.
ext: We explore the essential beneficence of the world, the sacrificed savior, what the Bible says about wizards with tiny hats, problems with scapegoating, the world age doctrine, cyclical time, reincarnating world teachers, stellar origins of Islam, the "contact experience," the spiritual place for psychedelics, and much more!
